description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page ('AdminCourseQueue.aspx.cs') in a system that manages administration of course queues. It handles page load events, checks session variables, interacts with SQL Server database to verify queue status for a course, and provides event handlers for navigation buttons and grid view selection.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing admin queue page; handles session validation, database interactions, and navigation for course queue management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; verifies session variables, checks course queue in the database, and potentially deletes empty queue entries.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Reloads or navigates to the current page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles grid view selection; stores selected student and course IDs in session and navigates to 'ShowAns.aspx'.
